verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack says Cactus loads or runs GGUF models; the only documented model path is an experimental `cactus convert` from HuggingFace, which is not GGUF-specific. Community posts note that Cactus vendored llama.cpp and that GGUF models could be downloaded via a demo-app link. However, the same hands-on report says the app crashed immediately when those models were selected, so there is no evidence of GGUF models actually running. Without a vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
